# Catchment population query tool

This provides estimates of catchment population sizes for individual hospitals, according to a proportional flow methodology. Population data: INSEE Hospital usage data: ATIH Please see the <a href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.28.26351911">pre-print</a> for further details on the data and methodology.

<iframe src="https://poigeo.shinyapps.io/explore_catchment/" width="100%" height="800" frameborder="0" style="background-color: lavenderblush;">

</iframe>

## <!-- [Speed-test of French numbers](french_numbers.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary} -->

# Mille-neuf-cent-quatre-vingt-dix-neuf

A game to improve speed at reading french numbers. Choose a number range, then click on "Lancer". You will be given a number as text, and you must write it as digits as quickly as you can. Your time be recorded and your results plotted on a graph.

<iframe src="https://poigeo.shinyapps.io/site/" width="100%" height="800" frameborder="0" style="background-color: lavenderblush;">

</iframe>
